subject: english
title: Reading: Use Context Clues

content.summary: Use nearby words and sentence structure to infer the meaning of an unfamiliar English word.

sections.heading: Look around the word
sections.body: Read the whole sentence and the sentence before and after it. Examples, contrasts, and definitions often provide clues.

sections.heading: Check the word class
sections.body: Decide whether the unknown word acts as a noun, verb, adjective, or adverb before choosing a meaning.

sections.heading: Test the meaning
sections.body: Replace the word with your guess and read the sentence again. Keep the meaning that fits both grammar and context.

provenance.authoringNote: Original instructional content authored for this repository; not copied or paraphrased from publisher textbooks.

studyHighlights: 先圈出未知字周圍的轉折、因果與舉例訊號。
把代入的意思放回整句，確認語氣與詞性一致。
若兩個選項都像，回看前後句的證據。
